texts: THE BAKER OPENED THE DOOR BEFORE THE SUN ROSE AND WALKED THROUGH THE QUIET STREET. A CHILD WAS SITTING BESIDE THE WINDOW WITH A BOOK ABOUT THE SEA. WHEN THE RAIN BEGAN THEY WENT INTO THE HOUSE AND PUT THE WET CLOTHES NEAR THE FIRE.

AFTER THE EVENING MEAL THE BAKER TOOK A LETTER FROM THE TABLE AND READ IT TO THE FAMILY. IT TOLD OF A LONG JOURNEY THROUGH THE MOUNTAINS AND A LITTLE VILLAGE WHERE PEOPLE GATHERED TO HEAR STORIES. EVERYONE LISTENED UNTIL THE LAST WORD.
